summary: Static code verification of REVISED Android 15+ status bar overlap fix in SpeakMateAI (React Native + Expo). Previous iteration_3 relied on SafeAreaView edges=['top'] which proved unreliable on user's Android 15 device. New fix replaces that with explicit `paddingTop: Math.max(insets.top, StatusBar.currentHeight ?? 0, 28) + offset` and changes SafeAreaView edges to ['left','right']. Also verified HomeScreen 'See all' same-row layout fix. Browser/Playwright N/A — RN app runs on device. User will rebuild APK to verify.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix pattern is correct & robust: Math.max(insets.top, StatusBar.currentHeight ?? 0, 28) guarantees a minimum 28px top padding even when both insets.top and StatusBar.currentHeight return 0 (the failure mode that broke iteration_3). On normal devices the actual inset (~28-34px) wins, on Android 15+ edge-to-edge bug case the 28px fallback wins — either way header clears the status bar.
SafeAreaView edges changed to ['left','right'] is correct — prevents double padding (SafeAreaView's top inset + manual paddingTop) on devices where both work.

HomeScreen 'See all' layout: flex:1 on Text + justifyContent:'space-between' on sectionRow is the canonical RN pattern for 'label + action on same row'. Removal of width:'100%' from FadeInView and flexShrink:1/marginRight from styles.section eliminates layout conflicts.

Unused imports note (minor, non-blocking): Some screens like ResumeUpload still import `Platform` from react-native even though Platform is no longer used after the fix. Lint may warn — main agent can clean up but not urgent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: React Native + Expo app. Cannot be browser-tested with Playwright — testing is static code verification only. User rebuilds local Android APK to validate on Android 15 device. This iteration's fix replaces iteration_3's SafeAreaView-only approach with an explicit Math.max+28 fallback that guarantees status bar clearance even when SafeAreaView insets return 0 (the bug case on Android 15+ targetSdk 36 edge-to-edge).
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (from main agent context): On Android 15+ with targetSdk 36 forcing edge-to-edge mode, react-native-safe-area-context's SafeAreaView edges=['top'] sometimes resolves the top inset to 0 instead of the actual ~28-32px status bar height. The previous fix's reliance on that inset alone produced ZERO top padding (just spacing.md=16px) — visually the header text overlapped the status bar icons. FIX: Use Math.max(insets.top, StatusBar.currentHeight ?? 0, 28) with a literal 28 floor ensures the header is always pushed below the status bar regardless of which API returns 0. SafeAreaView edges narrowed to ['left','right'] avoids double-padding when SafeAreaView DOES work.
